title: Blueberry and Ginger Sorbet
changes_from_base: Blueberries and a fresh ginger syrup replace the mango and lime; no corn syrup.
summary: Bright blueberries with a warm kick of fresh ginger, steeped in the syrup and strained out so the sorbet stays perfectly smooth.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Ginger syrup
steps.text: Simmer the sugar, water and sliced ginger for 5 min, then take off the heat and leave for 20 min. Strain and throw away the ginger.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the blueberries with the warm syrup until completely smooth.

steps.title: Strain
steps.text: Press through the sieve to remove the skins, then stir in the lemon juice and salt. Taste and add a little more lemon if it tastes flat.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and chill for at least 3 h.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn for 20-25 min until thick, pack into the container and freeze for at least 2 h.

tips: Leave the ginger in the syrup longer for more heat.
Frozen blueberries work well; thaw them first.
Sieving out the skins gives a much smoother sorbet.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
